description: An oil painting of a woman in a dark patterned headscarf and shawl cradling a thin, solemn child against her. Behind them is a tattered tent canopy, stacked grain sacks and several shadowed people, with dry ground and bare thorny trees in bright sun. No letters, frame, border or violence; fills the image edge to edge.
reason: Shows a mother and child at a famine-relief style camp with grain sacks under a tent, but the card is the 2015 Hatton Garden safe-deposit vault burglary in London; the picture is of a different event, with no vault, drilled wall, safe-deposit boxes or burglars.
